# Test fixtures

Small files used by pytest and by `app.py --self-test`.

| File | What it is | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `ocr_sample.pdf` | One-page, image-only PDF (no text layer) reading "The lighthouse keeper / recorded the storm / in his logbook." | Generated by `make_ocr_fixture.py` with the DejaVu Sans font shipped in matplotlib. |
| `speech_sample.mp3` | First 9 s of a LibriVox reading, 16 kHz mono, 32 kbit/s: "Dilemma, by J. K. Nicholson, from the Smart Set magazine, May 1920." | LibriVox *Short Story Collection 093*, track 2 (`ss093_02_various_64kb.mp3`, https://archive.org/details/ss093_2009_librivox). LibriVox recordings are public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0). Cut with `ffmpeg -i src.mp3 -t 9 -ac 1 -ar 16000 -b:a 32k`. |
